newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian May construction work up 30 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: Croatian May construction work up 30 pct y/y.

text.p: The value of construction works in Croatia rose to 693.3 million kuna in May, up 30 percent from the same month in 1996, the State Statistics Bureau reported on Friday.
It put the value of January-May works higher at 2.7 billion kuna, or 45 percent from the same period last year. The Bureau made no comparison with April.
The agreed value of building works for this year was put at 4.9 billion kuna, compared to 3.2 billion a year ago.

A total of 29,620 builders were employed at construction sites in May, 14 percent more than the same month last year. They put in a total of 5.2 million working hours, up 9.0 percent. These figures exclude engineers and technicians. -- Zagreb newsroom +385 1 455 7075
